title: Does KKR’s (KKR) India Hospital Deal And Fee Shift Reveal A New Earnings Playbook?
title_zh: KKR (KKR) 印度医院交易和费用调整是否揭示了新的盈利策略？
summary: KKR recently entered advanced talks to acquire Sweden-based Medicover’s 66.9% stake in its Indian hospital business for at least US$1.05 billion, while also reporting quarter-to-date monetization income above US$900 million, mostly from realized performance fees.
summary_zh: KKR 最近进入高级谈判，以至少 10.5 亿美元收购总部位于瑞典的 Medicover 在其印度医院业务中 66.9% 的股份，同时报告本季度迄今的货币化收入超过 9 亿美元，其中大部分来自已实现的绩效费用。

title: KKR (KKR) Eyes $1 Billion Plus Medicover Hospitals India Deal
title_zh: KKR (KKR) 着眼于印度 10 亿美元加医疗保险医院交易
summary: KKR is reported to be in advanced talks to acquire a majority stake in Medicover Hospitals India. The potential deal could be valued at more than $1b and would expand KKR's healthcare platform in India.
summary_zh: 据报道，KKR 正在就收购印度 Medicover Hospitals 多数股权进行深入谈判。这笔潜在交易的价值可能超过 10 亿美元，并将扩大 KKR 在印度的医疗保健平台。

title: American Airlines (AAL) Brings Starlink To 500 Planes And Signs Google Fuel Deal
title_zh: 美国航空 (AAL) 为 500 架飞机配备 Starlink 并签署 Google 燃油协议
summary: American Airlines Group announced plans to equip over 500 aircraft with SpaceX Starlink high-speed in-flight Wi-Fi starting in 2027. The company also entered a three-year sustainable aviation fuel partnership with Google to support emissions reduction efforts.
summary_zh: 美国航空集团宣布计划从 2027 年开始为 500 多架飞机配备 SpaceX Starlink 高速机上 Wi-Fi。该公司还与谷歌建立了为期三年的可持续航空燃料合作伙伴关系，以支持减排工作。

title: How To Invest: 5 Tips For Dealing With This Stock Market
title_zh: 如何投资：应对股市的 5 个技巧
summary: The power trend has generated impressive gains. Get ready to deal with whatever comes next with five guidelines for how to invest.
summary_zh: 电力趋势已经产生了令人印象深刻的收益。准备好应对接下来发生的任何事情，并提供五项投资指南。

title: ARES vs. KKR: Which Asset Manager Offers Better Upside Now?
title_zh: ARES 与 KKR：哪个资产管理公司现在提供更好的优势？
summary: Ares Management and KKR & Co are benefiting from growing AUM, strategic acquisitions and expanding investment capabilities. Which stock is the better pick now?
summary_zh: Ares Management 和 KKR & Co 正受益于不断增长的资产管理规模、战略收购和不断扩大的投资能力。现在选择哪只股票更好？
